purpose: Development-only sentinel for a future semantic judging process; not agent trajectories, reward implementation, statistical reliability or evidence of model improvement.
construction_notes: Question facts authored from literal questions before candidates; equal weights within question, no extra unasked clauses.
The unrelated-valid-quote category includes one strictly clipped citation. Quote bytes are valid but do not support the answer; this is distinct from fabrication.
All source inspection records are explicitly assumed counterfactual preconditions, not genuine execution logs. Gaps require real recorded inspection when used in a future agent evaluation.
References may help a judge check correctness but cannot substitute for support in the candidates own citations.
Labels remain provisional model-assisted; no independent human review.
No ambiguous derivations included; none excluded after judge scoring because no judge has run.
Validation labels/categories/expected scores must never be judge examples or prompt tuning inputs; public file separation is not access control.
Any tuning informed by later judge failures retires this set into design and requires fresh development checks; reserved reader evaluation stays unused.

Fact correctness includes binding each measurement to its asserted conditions and baseline. A true raw number attached to incompatible hardware/baseline is not a supported measurement fact. The all-material gate also covers optional assertions outside the requested facts.
